column1: # BLIND scan sheet -- doc pdhd/stm-tagger-chain sec 13
# Gate on retile_wrapped_channel_activity.  Doc sec 12 measured that this knob
# raises the Steiner terminal ceiling 3.6x (0.134 -> 0.484 eligible points) and
# is the only knob that moves the sec 8.6 coverage number.  This scan decides
# whether the STM verdicts it moves get BETTER.
# Population: run 029107, 30 events, all 224 clusters whose STM verdict differs
# between the knob off and on (of 2246 verdicts, 10.0%).  130 gain the tag, 94
# lose it.  The (event, cluster) key sets of the two arms are identical, so the
# knob changes no cluster partition -- only the Steiner stage.
# The arms' verdicts are NOT here.  They are in pdhd_retile_scan_key.tsv, which
# should stay closed until the labels are in.
# QUESTION, per cluster, from the RAW CHARGE alone: does this track enter the
# detector and STOP inside it, or does it pass through / exit?
#   label = STM      enters and stops inside the active volume
#           THRU     through-going, or exits any face (incl. anode / cathode)
#           UNCLEAR  cannot tell -- fragment, too sparse, overlapping, ambiguous
# Please do NOT switch on steiner_graph / steiner_terminals / stm_fit /
# stm_tagged while labelling.  Those layers differ between the arms and would
# reveal which arm you are seeing.  The clustering and dead-area layers are
# byte-identical between the arms (verified by member hash), so raw charge is
# genuinely blind.
# STRATA -- please label BOTH, they answer different questions:
#   A  npts >= 200  (n=174 of 224)  do the knob's changes on real tracks improve?
#   B  npts <  200  (n= 50 of 224)  the knob's new tags are 47 gain / 3 lose on
#                                   these, i.e. 36% of ALL its gains are on small
#                                   clusters.  Are those real stoppers, or is it
#                                   manufacturing STM tags on fragments?  This is
#                                   the half most likely to argue against the knob.
# tranche 1 = rows 1-63 (A: 20 gain + 20 lose; B: 20 gain + all 3 lose).
# Coordinates are cm.  PDHD active volume x -358..358, y 7.6..606, z 0.2..462.
